description: Adds WebRTC video/voice calling with room management, screen sharing, and participant grid.

integrations: LiveKit or Daily.co for SFU signaling
architectureNotes: VideoRoom manages local/remote media streams and participant grid layout.
CallControls provides mute/unmute, camera toggle, screen share, and leave buttons.
ParticipantTile renders a single video with name overlay and audio indicator.
Wire /api/room/token to generate room access tokens from your signaling provider.
For production, use LiveKit Cloud or self-hosted LiveKit server.
